title: Word Of Your Bani, Lord, Is Ambrosial
summary: Attachment is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: The Word of Your Bani, Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar
lifeApplication: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
